_note: CALIBRATION gold set C (APInvoices) — labels are Claude's best guess for Robert to CORRECT. Reinforces tiers 6 (chained_calls) and 7 (planning_agent). Distinct domain from the others and the nine scoring visions. 'tier' tags per candidate (NOT sent to the judge). gold_borderline=true marks adjacent<->off_domain seams. pair_id C_exc links a matched 6<->7 pair (same relevance, two tiers; mismatch = tier drift).

vision.purpose: A tool for an accounts-payable clerk that turns incoming vendor invoices into validated, ready-to-post accounting entries.
target_audience: AP clerks processing high volumes of vendor invoices
Finance teams that want fewer manual invoice-entry errors

invoice_extraction.description: Extracts structured fields (vendor, line items, totals, PO number) from an invoice image or PDF.

three_way_match.description: Runs a fixed pipeline that extracts the invoice, matches it against the purchase order and the receiving record, and flags any discrepancies.

exception_summary.description: Summarizes why an invoice failed matching so the clerk knows what to fix.

candidates.name: invoice_field_extraction
candidates.rough_description: Extracts the structured fields from an invoice document.
candidates.note: invoice_extraction IS this. Necessity, cite invoice_extraction.

candidates.name: three_way_match_pipeline
candidates.rough_description: The fixed extract, then match-to-PO, then match-to-receiving, then flag-discrepancy sequence that produces the match result.
candidates.note: three_way_match IS this fixed pipeline. Necessity, cite three_way_match.

candidates.name: discrepancy_explanation
candidates.rough_description: Explains, in plain language, why an invoice failed the match.
candidates.note: exception_summary IS this. Necessity, cite exception_summary.

candidates.name: fixed_exception_triage
candidates.rough_description: On a match failure, a fixed pipeline pulls the PO, pulls the vendor's recent invoices, and produces a suggested resolution for the clerk.
candidates.note: Matched pair C_exc (low tier). Resolving a flagged exception serves the validated-entries purpose; three_way_match only flags, it does not resolve. Adjacent.

candidates.name: autonomous_exception_investigator
candidates.rough_description: On a match failure, an autonomous agent decides at each step whether to query the PO, the receiving record, vendor history, or prior corrections, until it proposes a resolution.
candidates.note: Matched pair C_exc (high tier). Relevance (resolve the flagged exception) is IDENTICAL to fixed_exception_triage; only mechanism/tier differs. Should also be adjacent. Difference = tier drift.

candidates.name: ap_policy_qa
candidates.rough_description: Answers the clerk's questions about payment terms and tax handling by retrieving from the company's AP policy documents, with citations.
candidates.note: SEAM (alpha): no purpose phrase mentions policy Q&A, so a phrase-anchored judge has little to cite (likely off_domain); but producing a correct entry (the stated job) is plausibly served by resolving a terms/tax question. Proposed adjacent.

candidates.name: autonomous_spend_optimizer
candidates.rough_description: An autonomous agent that analyzes all past invoices to find savings and drafts renegotiations of vendor contracts.
candidates.note: SEAM (beta): the 'invoices/spend' surface tempts a phrase-anchored judge, but the vision turns one invoice into one validated entry; spend optimization and contract renegotiation serve no stated job. Proposed off_domain.

candidates.name: employee_expense_reimbursement
candidates.rough_description: Handles employee expense reports and reimbursements.
candidates.note: Employee expenses are a different flow from vendor invoices. Guardrail.

candidates.name: duplicate_invoice_detection
candidates.rough_description: Flags when an incoming invoice is a likely duplicate of one already processed.
candidates.note: Serves the fewer-errors purpose; not required by any stated feature. Enhancement.
